title: A simple and extendable frontend template for new projects.
lead: {{appName}} is a neutral web app shell prepared for later brand and domain content.
founderParagraphs: This template provides a reusable frontend foundation.
Project-specific decisions are completed later in content, design, and integration layers.
methodologyParagraphs: Infrastructure stays in place while domain copy and commerce flows are cleared by default.
A new project can build on this shell with its own information architecture and content sources.
experienceParagraphs: Home, blog, contact, FAQ, account, legal pages, theme, and SEO foundations remain.
The brand name is managed through env and the AppName token.

differentiators.title: Preserved shell
differentiators.body: Routing, auth, i18n, and theme foundations remain usable.

differentiators.title: Easy adaptation
differentiators.body: New domain content can come from DB or CMS records.

authorBio: {{appName}} content is prepared to be completed by project teams with their own brand and product decisions.
